name: smwmusic-illusion-of-gaia-ominous-whispers
title: Illusion of Gaia - Ominous Whispers
description:
Your hero turns his head and notices a pale spirit appeearance. He's then told he is sitting on an ancient Maya graveyard. Useful for adventure-like ruins explorations.

It ranked 38/46 at Super Famicompo 2. Due to weird de-syncs, I had to re-write some note lengths using the latest, more accurate version of vgmtrans.
